mechanism.forward: For each nonempty anchored original-position bin, mix fixed .5 local hidden plus .5 shared whole-history hidden BEFORE its unchanged eight export rows and one bias. Empty local bins zero their whole eight-coordinate export slice after bias. Existing downstream global mixing remains unchanged.
mechanism.export_weights: ONE SINGLE freshly initialized export weight/bias tensor is shared by the local/global pooling routes. Shape, registration and RNG draw order remain V8-identical; never load V8/V6 trained parameter values.

causal_semantics.timestamp: All four export slices are coordinates of the embedding at the CURRENT requested cutoff t, not separate embeddings stamped at bin endpoints
causal_semantics.whole_history: Only valid states at or before current cutoff t may enter the shared whole-history vector. Later-in-window PAST context may enter an older anchored slice only as part of this endpoint embedding.
causal_semantics.unchanged: Strict causal Transformer mask and backward-only temporal relation bank remain unchanged; pooling must never bypass the cutoff or validity mask
